narrative.headline: CLI/MCP for Costco Same-Day GraphQL plus gated REST cancel on sameday.costco.com.
narrative.value_prop: Search, cart, checkout preview, tip update, dual-gated FinalizeCheckout, and REST order cancel — without exposing VGS tokenization or ungated charge.
narrative.auth_narrative: Authenticate with a Costco Same-Day browser session (cookies after Azure B2C SSO). Run auth login or import a local jar, then doctor.

troubleshoots.fix: Run auth login or restore cookie jar for sameday.costco.com.
Pass --yes for live PUT cancel, or --dry-run to simulate.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Costco Same-Day cart/checkout/cancel against sameday.costco.com with honest charge and cancel gates.
anti_triggers: Do not place a live order without explicit intent and both --yes and --confirm-charge
Do not commit HARs, credentials, or card data
